source.title: Semantic-Geometric Dual Compression: Training-Free Visual Token Reduction for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding
source.important_scope_note: The attached 19-page PDF ends with references and contains no appendix, although pages 8-9 refer to implementation details in an appendix.

benchmark.name: XLRS-Bench
benchmark.metric: subtask accuracy as reported; Avg is the macro average over 13 subtasks; the exact scorer is not specified
benchmark.paper_statement: All models use the defaults of their respective papers and the same evaluation protocol.

router.training_mode: offline pre-training, then frozen during downstream inference

scsa.importance_aggregation: sum of CLS-to-patch attention within each cluster
scsa.tau_behavior: monotonic with lambda; concrete formula and constants are not stated
scsa.representative_behavior: small clusters use a peak representative; large clusters use weighted averaging

igsr.local_difference: squared norm of F minus 3x3 average-pooled F
igsr.topology: greedy paths choose the highest structural cost among N_n(v_t) candidates that strictly decrease Chebyshev distance to the next anchor

reproducibility_blockers: The numerical values of alpha, beta, rho_min, tau(lambda), and the cluster-size threshold are absent.
The Router instruction encoder/pooling, shared-MLP layers, head structures, Sigmoid placement, and rho-range mapping are not specified.
SCSA predecessor neighborhoods and IGSR region/order, tie, normalization, AvgPool boundary, path-overlap, budget-padding, parallelization, and greedy-neighbor rules are not specified.
Router optimizer, schedule, epochs, batch size, split, loss weights, seed, label-generation artifact, and checkpoint identity are absent.
Dataset sample count, evaluated split, exact prompt, answer parser, scorer, and evaluation script are absent.
Hardware, precision, software versions, timing repetitions, timing boundaries, and a profiler-backed FLOPs recipe are absent.
The cited appendix is not present in the attached PDF.
